subject.title: fix(browser): snapshots fail when managed proxy is enabled

question: Should managed-proxy browser sessions permit this temporary, exact-endpoint direct bypass for the policy-validated CDP WebSocket handed to Playwright?
rationale: The patch is mechanically focused and has real after-fix evidence, but the acceptable proxy/SSRF boundary is repository security policy rather than a purely testable implementation detail.

options.title: Approve the scoped CDP bypass
options.body: Confirm that a validated CDP WebSocket may retain the exact managed-proxy bypass through Playwright attachment while remote endpoints remain subject to configured policy.

options.title: Require a different boundary design
options.body: Keep the bug open until maintainers specify a proxy-compatible Playwright connection design that avoids this direct-bypass contract.

recommendation.title: Approve the scoped CDP bypass
recommendation.body: Confirm that a validated CDP WebSocket may retain the exact managed-proxy bypass through Playwright attachment while remote endpoints remain subject to configured policy.

likelyOwner.reason: Their merged loopback-CDP bypass work is the closest established implementation precedent for the boundary being extended.
